description: This file defines a migration class for updating the database schema and localization strings for version 5.5.0 of the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for creating tables, altering columns, inserting language strings, setting workflow states, and menu configuration specific to the claim module.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class that handles database and localization updates for OrangeHRM version 5.5.0, specifically for the claim module. It extends AbstractMigration and includes methods for schema modifications, workflow setup, menu configuration, and localization string management.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps to update database schema, insert permissions, configure menu items, and initialize workflow states for the claim module during the upgrade.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '5.5.0' indicating the migration version.

methods.name: checkClaimExists
methods.description: Checks if the Claim menu item already exists in the database.

methods.name: getScreenId
methods.description: Retrieves the screen ID for a given screen name.

methods.name: getParentId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a menu item based on its title and parent ID.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes localization translations for a specific language string unit ID.

methods.name: modifyClaimTables
methods.description: Alters existing claim-related tables to update column types and character sets for compatibility.

methods.name: modifyClaimRequestCurrencyToForeignKey
methods.description: Modifies the 'currency' column in 'ohrm_claim_request' to be a foreign key to 'hs_hr_currency_type'.

methods.name: changeClaimExpenseTypeTableStatusToBoolean
methods.description: Converts the 'status' column in 'ohrm_expense_type' to boolean and updates existing data accordingly.

methods.name: changeClaimEventTableStatusToBoolean
methods.description: Converts the 'status' column in 'ohrm_claim_event' to boolean and updates existing data.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version number of language strings to the current migration version.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy initializes and retrieves an instance of LangStringHelper for managing language strings.

methods.name: insertI18nGroups
methods.description: Inserts default internationalization groups into the database.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Inserts a new menu item into the database with specified parameters.

methods.name: insertWorkflowState
methods.description: Inserts a workflow state transition into the workflow state machine table.

methods.name: deleteClaimWorkflowStates
methods.description: Removes existing claim workflow states before inserting new ones.

methods.name: removeMarketplaceTables
methods.description: Drops marketplace-specific tables if they exist.

methods.name: updateI18nGroups
methods.description: Updates group membership for specific internationalization strings.
